introHtml: Rtic lanyards and badges combine the rugged durability of a brand known for outdoor gear with practical everyday use. Ideal for field crews, safety teams, or event staff who need ID holders that can handle moisture and heavy use. Choose from breakaway or swivel hook styles, and add your logo with screen printing or debossing for a clean, professional look.
